frontmatter.title: From Demoralization to Outage: The Anatomy of a Software Collapse
frontmatter.subheading: Why most production disasters are cultural failures long before they are technical ones
frontmatter.excerpt: This article breaks down the four stages of systemic software collapse-demoralization, destabilization, crisis, and normalization-and shows how teams unknowingly engineer their own failures.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
